candidates.name: Coordinate transformation formats
verified_facts: OS documents accepted coordinate representations including ETRS89 geodetic, ETRS89 XYZ and National Grid eastings/northings with optional height.
Formatting defines how a coordinate is expressed for transformation and lookup workflows.
semantic_limits: More decimal places or a supported coordinate notation does not establish measurement precision, positional accuracy, correct datum, GNSS quality or terrain-source uncertainty.

candidates.name: Grid InQuest II transformation software
verified_facts: Grid InQuest II transforms between ETRS89 and OSGB36 National Grid using OSTN15/OSGM15 and supports single or batch coordinate transformations.
The software is an implementation vehicle for the national transformation models.
semantic_limits: Correct transformation software does not remove source GNSS errors, antenna-processing errors, parcel-geometry uncertainty, DTM sampling error or measurement uncertainty from its input data.
